name: Smart RTL Post
author: Luqman Safay

sections.description:
Smart RTL Post changes your post layout direction to right-to-left for languages like Pashto, Arabic, and Urdu with just one click.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the smart-rtl-post folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from the ‘Plugins’ page in WordPress.
